{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Well, you know what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:11.740
    | text      = It's technically true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:13.379
    | text      = Very affecting emotionally and it's like a really inspiring story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I've watched a number of interviews with him and videos.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:24.180

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.740
    | text      = And you should start it.
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:33.379
    | text      = I will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:34.379
    | text      = Any moment now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.379
    | text      = So Jordan, I mentioned a while back that Tucker was putting out a five-part series explaining
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.259
    | text      = what really happened on 9-11, which I likened to him trying to wear Alex's skin and steal
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:45.980
    | text      = his spirit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.579
    | text      = It may seem kind of trivial now, and there's a low social cost to being a conspiracy theorist,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:53.199
    | text      = but in the early 2000s, people hated 9-11 conspiracy theorists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:58.939
    | text      = The US had suffered a giant terrorist attack, a city was grieving, and the armed forces
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:03.180
    | text      = of the country were being called up to fight in multiple foreign wars, presumably in response
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:08.220
    | text      = to that attack.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:10.040
    | text      = The country wasn't fully united, but you could say that there were two main sides, and neither
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:14.560
    | text      = really liked conspiracy theories around 9-11 that much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:18.339
    | text      = There was the America right or wrong crowd, who saw Bush as a wartime president who had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:22.560
    | text      = responded to the attack, and it was every American's duty to go along and support him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:27.540
    | text      = in getting this mission done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:29.060
    | text      = That was his high approval rating, period.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.339
    | text      = For them, it was unpatriotic to question the leadership, and they demanded that we all
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:36.699
    | text      = support the troops.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:38.439
    | text      = On the other side, you had the anti-war crowd, who were generally college kids and old hippies,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:43.579
    | text      = mostly from the left and libertarian circles, and for the most part, they weren't that into
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:47.699
    | text      = 9-11 conspiracies either.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:50.040
    | text      = They had a solid argument against the wars, and their conviction that Bush lied to make
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:53.879
    | text      = those wars happen didn't rely on really dubious arguments that these conspiracy theorists
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:58.980
    | text      = make about the attack itself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:01.560
    | text      = Incorporating flimsy accusations about Bush doing 9-11 into their arguments weakened them,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.560
    | text      = so for the most part, they stayed away from this kind of game.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.199
    | text      = You'll often hear Alex complain that when he criticized Bush, the right wing accused
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:14.360
    | text      = him of being a commie, and the whole 9-11 period has a lot to do with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.439
    | text      = Prior to this point, he'd had very little national significance, but he'd made a career
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:23.959
    | text      = that was almost fully catering to a right wing audience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.519
    | text      = He was a John Birch Society acolyte who worked on Pat Buchanan's campaigns for president,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:32.200
    | text      = and pretty much all of his positions would be categorized as strongly conservative.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:37.159
    | text      = I do hate to be too praising of Alex, but in his coverage of 9-11, what he did was a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.139
    | text      = bold move, and it's one that could have easily backfired.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.340
    | text      = The population he'd regularly drawn his audience from was in a very patriotic phase, and a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.299
    | text      = lot of the Republican types might punch you for saying that you thought 9-11 was an inside
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:56.419
    | text      = job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:57.580
    | text      = It was alienating to what was obviously his core demographic, but Alex on some level understood
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.799
    | text      = that this was his ticket.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.779
    | text      = There wasn't going to be another publicly traumatic event on this scale in the United
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:08.460
    | text      = States for a long time, and if he could attach himself to it by demanding people accept his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.379
    | text      = alternative version of the story, he could make his mark in this very wet cement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.139
    | text      = It truly was a different time, and although I'm certain there were crass financial considerations
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.539
    | text      = and Alex didn't believe most of this shit, it's important to keep in mind how hard it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.519
    | text      = was to be a person like that in 2002.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.580
    | text      = The country was trying to come together and heal, and Alex made it his business to try
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:36.220
    | text      = to keep these wounds open, insisting that if you let them heal, you'll never find the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.659
    | text      = true culprit, the globalists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:43.500
    | text      = I say all this not to pump Alex up, because he's still a liar and a fraud and even was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:47.659
    | text      = back then, but instead I say this to disrespect Tucker Carlson and the idea that he would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:52.539
    | text      = make a 9-11 conspiracy documentary 24 years later and act like he's breaking new ground.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:59.460
    | text      = When it would have been an interesting position to have, Tucker was wearing bow ties on crossfire
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.620
    | text      = and arguing in favor of Bush's wars in Iraq and Afghanistan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:08.419
    | text      = He was trying to be a mouthpiece for the state, so he hated the idea that people had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.620
    | text      = conspiracies about 9-11.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:14.899
    | text      = He said as much to Alex in one of their interviews that he deeply disliked Alex because he thought
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:19.700
    | text      = the conspiracies about 9-11 were disgusting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:23.299
    | text      = But now the calculus has changed entirely, and there is no cost to being a 9-11 theorist,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:29.019
    | text      = and it comes to Tucker to try to steal Alex's crown by making this five-part 9-11 conspiracy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.259
    | text      = series.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.500
    | text      = There are no ifs, ands, or buts about one thing, I think, and that is that Alex Jones
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:41.580
    | text      = is the 9-11 guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.620
    | text      = He's wrong about pretty much everything and he doesn't even remember all the fake things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.019
    | text      = he's proven over the years, but he was the guy who took on the risk of being the face
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.379
    | text      = of a deeply unpopular thing when the country wanted no part of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.820
    | text      = If you're Tucker, who is supposedly Alex's friend, you can't make a 9-11 series and not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:00.620
    | text      = have it mostly be about Alex's work, because whatever you're going to put into that documentary,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.580
    | text      = he's probably already covered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:08.659
    | text      = If you're Tucker, you should just plug loose change and move on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.940
    | text      = Call it a day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:12.940
    | text      = And if he hasn't already covered it, that's you indicting him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.259
    | text      = Mm-hmm, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.259
    | text      = That he did nothing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:18.259
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.259
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.259
    | text      = All his work and all of that risk that he took on amounted to him just being wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.500
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.500
    | text      = I say all this, and I am interested in this move on Tucker's part because I believe that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:29.679
    | text      = it's part of a concerted effort to replace Alex as a meaningful figure in the Trump media
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.620
    | text      = ecosystem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:35.700
    | text      = Alex is too embarrassing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:36.700
    | text      = He has too much baggage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:37.899
    | text      = It has to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.899
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.899
    | text      = And so Tucker seems like he's well positioned to slide into this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.419
    | text      = He can't be the guy who predicted 9-11 or blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, but give him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.580
    | text      = the, he's the expert spot and now you've got-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:51.299
    | text      = He's serious and he's doing hard work on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:53.460
    | text      = And now you don't even need Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:55.240
    | text      = You can just be like, oh, Alex predicted it, but this guy's the expert on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:59.179
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:00.259
    | text      = I believe that putting out a documentary series about 9-11 and 2025 is an effort of usurpation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:08.220
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.220
    | text      = Trying to steal this thing from Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.860
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.860
    | text      = But maybe, hey, maybe it's possible that Tucker broke new ground on 9-11 and you know, maybe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.299
    | text      = has a smoking gun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.419
    | text      = If you put out, like say now, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:21.179
    | text      = If I put out a, let's say like thousand hour documentary on the civil war, I'm coming for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:28.659
    | text      = Ken Burns.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.659
    | text      = If I put out a two hour documentary on the civil war, I'm not coming for Ken Burns, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.340
    | text      = if I put out enough, Ken Burns is watching out, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.139
    | text      = Like that's-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.139
    | text      = Well, it's a five part series and it's, they're half hour long.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.139
    | text      = So they're not, you know, it's not the same as a thousand-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.580
    | text      = But they're lazy, these are all lazy people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.139
    | text      = So that is a lot of work for their benchmarks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.379
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.379
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.379
    | text      = It's definitely, there's intent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:53.460
    | text      = There's like the intent of a thousand hours behind it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.259
    | text      = Yes, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:57.259
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.259
    | text      = So I thought that we would watch the first episode and see what kind of feelings it evokes,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.860
    | text      = see where we see if it feels worth covering more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.700
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.820
    | text      = So we're going to jump in here at the beginning of his first episode of the, we're going to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.100
    | text      = all the truth about 9-11 baby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:17.940
    | text      = Okay, all right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:19.019
    | text      = For 24 years now, politicians, the media, Intel agencies in this country and abroad
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.379
    | text      = have all demanded that you believe the official story about 9-11.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:29.659
    | text      = And here's what it is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.139
    | text      = They tell you a group of Al-Qaeda affiliated terrorists, many of whom were known to US
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:35.779
    | text      = Intel services, somehow managed to evade capture for years as they planned the most significant
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:42.059
    | text      = and elaborate terror attack in human history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.820
    | text      = We're told that despite repeated encounters with the FBI, the CIA, local law enforcement,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:51.379
    | text      = airport security, foreign Intel organizations, the right information somehow never made it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:58.580
    | text      = to the right people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:00.279

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:37.380

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:45.019

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:50.240
    | text      = news reports and declassified government documents.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.960
    | text      = So I'm all for it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:29.319
    | text      = Right, but you know I think that there's a way to do things that's within the law and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But I'll wait until he lays out some more evidence to make up his mind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:51.559
    | text      = This is all just kind of a blowhard preamble thing he's doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:55.880
    | text      = I do appreciate this because this is something that is still true.

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:18.119

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:21.500
    | text      = That's the only thing people won't just be like, oh well then I guess we're done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:26.500
    | text      = So Tucker brings up his first non-cuke guest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.619
    | text      = And this is the person who's going to be the subject of the first episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:36.680
    | text      = Telling the full story requires starting before the attacks going back to something called
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Alec Station, that was the CIA's bin Laden unit in 1999.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.759
    | text      = My name is Mark Rossini.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:49.180
    | text      = I'm a former FBI agent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.900

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:58.059
    | text      = representative to Alec Station at CIA headquarters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:02.019

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:05.940
    | text      = Station, so let's just establish that nothing that he's saying in this interview is new.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:10.900
    | text      = At the risk of being accused of shooting the messenger, I feel like I should tell you a
}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:20.940

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = five felony counts of criminally accessing the FBI databases.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:31.180
    | text      = This story gets a little bit messy, so strap in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:33.900
    | text      = I bet he's probably great with women.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:36.460
    | text      = In the 90s and early 2000s, Anthony Palacano became a big name in terms of private investigator
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:42.380
    | text      = business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:43.380

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:47.220
    | text      = up dirt on people who accused them of wrongdoing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:50.619
    | text      = Over the years, the private investigation business started to drift into being more
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.299

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.059
    | text      = So his job was literal victim blaming?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:05.740
    | text      = Well, interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:07.740
    | text      = Hold on to that thought.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:10.000
    | text      = He worked with a couple of lawyers and he didn't mind doing illegal things in order
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:13.400
    | text      = to help his clients.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:15.019
    | text      = He'd been considered very slimy for most of his career, and one of the best examples of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:19.420
    | text      = that is in relation to Michael Jackson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:22.259
    | text      = Palacano famously produced an audio tape alleged to be the father of one of the child victims,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:26.619
    | text      = expressing that he just wanted to extort Jackson, which played a big role in hurting the credibility
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:34.940
    | text      = The father in question denied this tape's authenticity, but that smear had been born
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = and it was in everyone's head.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:40.900

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = than molest them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:50.460
    | text      = Great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:51.460
    | text      = But his actions remained and he had already...

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:53.660
    | text      = Funny how that works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:54.660
    | text      = So, you know, the victim blaming and...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:56.180
    | text      = No, no, no, I take it back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:04.900
    | text      = So the depths of Palacano's shithead awfulness could take up a whole episode, so just suffice
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
